keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Aaron Long (Los Angeles Football Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Los Angeles Football Club 0, Minnesota United FC 1. Joaquín Pereyra (Minnesota United FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

Goal! Los Angeles Football Club 0, Minnesota United FC 2. Cherrion Valerius (Minnesota United FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Kelvin Yeboah with a headed pass.
Igor Jesus (Los Angeles Football Club) is shown the yellow card.
